features.evidence: Activated on 2026-07-29 after production deployment recovery. The user approved the access rule: all invited, authenticated employees may mutate Projects; public signup and anonymous sign-ins are disabled in Supabase Auth. Production deployment dpl_E7Kem5SnmYHkJCA5JmmXkhZF2zdG reached READY with email/password sign-in, invite callback and password-setup routes, session status, and protected create/edit routes. create_project, update_project, and archive_project now require auth.uid(), deny anon EXECUTE, and grant EXECUTE only to authenticated; all six privileges and all guards were verified. Browser verification confirmed login rendering and /projects/new redirects an unauthenticated visitor to /login?next=/projects/new. On user authorization, an invitation was sent to the supplied employee email through Supabase on 2026-07-29. A login failure was traced to the Supabase Email provider being disabled; it was re-enabled and its persisted dashboard state is Enabled, while public signup and anonymous sign-ins remain disabled. Auth logs subsequently confirmed successful authenticated /user requests from the production site. Production deployment dpl_5Tauc4mjJM1QKrmECxYw4Lax9hrL is READY and verified to show the authenticated-employee write-access notice and New Project control. Real authenticated create/edit/archive verification remains pending.
